description: This file implements the <trace> element for the Minilang scripting language in Apache OFBiz, providing mechanisms to toggle tracing at a specified level during script execution.

classes.name: Trace
classes.description: Implements the <trace> element, enabling tracing during script execution with configurable level.

classes.name: TraceFactory
classes.description: Factory class for creating instances of Trace.

methods.name: Trace(Element element, SimpleMethod simpleMethod)
methods.description: Constructor that initializes Trace with attributes from XML element, validating 'level' and reading nested operations.

methods.name: exec(MethodContext methodContext)
methods.description: Executes the trace operation: turns on tracing, runs nested operations, then turns off tracing.

methods.name: toString()
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the trace element with its level.
